svg.title: Residents test English and Bengali consent fields that grant different authority.
svg.desc: The deterministic English overlay will say that data may be used for this request only, while the working Bengali overlay grants use across all connected services. Both remain blank in generated art and blocked for named human review. Ila recognises that the choices are not equivalent.
svg.text: Page 24, panel 1 · Eye-level wide shot across the public service annex testing desks

text.tspan: Testing reveals that the incomplete translation does
not let residents review the same legal choice.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
